clauses.title: Scope – Gives specifications
clauses.text: 1.  Scope -  Gives specifications for hexagon head screws with threads from M5 up to and including M64 of product grade C.

clauses.title: Dimensions – M5, M6,
clauses.text: 2.  Dimensions - M5, M6, M8, M10, M12, M16, M20, M24, M30, M36, M42, M48, M56 and M64. Note -  For details, of preferred and non preferred threads size refer to Tables 1 and 2 of the  Standard).

clauses.title: Non
clauses.text: 2.2 Non - Preferred thneads - M14, M22, M27, M33, M39,  M45, M52, M60
